notes: Feral cat wears the HARNESS variant of druid tier. Druid tier splits three ways by role and the split is confirmed on stats from the pinned db, not on names: Malorne Harness chest 29096 carries Str 33 / Agi 34, while Regalia 29091 and Raiment 29087 carry Int/Spirit/SpellDamage. Upstream's own feral cat p2 gear set uses 29096 and 29100.

Token IDs come from the AtlasLoot loot tables in vendor/atlasloot/data-tbc.lua, which name each token in a trailing comment; druid uses the 'Defender' token of each drop triple, the sibling of the 'Champion' token ret uses. Zones and bosses come from data/atlasloot_sources.json and match ret-tokens.json boss-for-boss.

UNVERIFIED against Wowhead, unlike ret-tokens.json. The piece-to-token join here is by armour SLOT within a tier, because no committed source states the redemption pairing: db.json carries setName and classAllowlist but no token link, and AtlasLoot lists the tokens without the pieces they buy. Repeated Wowhead fetches did not return the redemption list. The slot join is sound for the slot, and 'Defender is the druid/warrior/priest token' is the assumption that still needs a human check.

T6 (Thunderheart) coverage added 2026-08-07 for four of five slots. NOT by the slot-join assumption above: the T6 token vocabulary is Conqueror/Vanquisher/Protector, not T4/T5's Champion/Defender/Hero, and the class groupings were re-cut rather than renamed. Chestguard of the Forgotten Protector (31091) is Warrior/Hunter/Shaman on its item page, so 'druid uses the Defender-equivalent' would have been wrong. Druid T6 is the VANQUISHER token (Rogue/Mage/Druid).

The T6 piece-to-token pairing is directly witnessed, not inferred: each Vanquisher token's Wowhead 'Currency for' list names the Thunderheart pieces it buys (vendor Tydormu). That list is the redemption source the note above says no committed input states -- it exists, it is just not in AtlasLoot or db.json. Zones/bosses below come from data/atlasloot_sources.json keyed on the TOKEN id, and independently match the boss recorded on the feral p3 Wowhead list for all four pieces.

T6 shoulders (31048 Thunderheart Pauldrons, token 31102 Pauldrons of the Forgotten Vanquisher) is DELIBERATELY OMITTED: the fetch was rate-limited before its 'Currency for' list could be read, and the other four were added only because they were each checked. Adding it on the pattern would be exactly the unwitnessed inference this map's history warns about. AtlasLoot puts 31102 at Mother Shahraz / Black Temple, which matches the feral p3 guide row -- that agreement is suggestive but does not establish the redemption pairing. Verify the 'Currency for' list, then add it.
